answer_1.quote: Table-to-text generation is a sub-task of data-to-text generation, aiming to generate natural language descriptions from structured tables.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our models on both surface-level matching metrics and logical fidelity scores. Surface-level metrics include BLEU-1/2/3... In terms of fidelity scores, prior works adopt SP-Acc and NLI-Acc... we add TAPEX-Acc and TAPAS-Acc.

answer_4.quote: We perform a human evaluation on the outputs of BART, T5, and PLOG models... We hire three human annotators to rate each sentence a score in the discrete range between 0 and 3, according to the criteria: Non-sense (0), Wrong (1), Partially correct (2), Correct (3).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated sentence on a 0-3 scale: 0 Non-sense, 1 Wrong (fluent but logically false), 2 Partially correct (some facts correct, some errors), 3 Correct (high quality in both fluency and logical correctness).
